title: Un día con Tito 🐘 | Manos, dientes, baño y a dormir | Canciones Infantiles
world: Tito's house through one day: sunny kitchen (morning), turquoise bathroom (evening), cozy bedroom with starry night window (night)
story: Morning: Tito wakes up and runs to breakfast with paint on his hands (problem)
Mamá: hands first! Washing with foam and bubbles (habit 1)
After playing outside Tito is muddy: bath time with bubbles and splash (habit 2)
Brushing teeth up and down in front of the mirror (habit 3)
Pajamas, a story with Mamá, a goodnight kiss (habit 4)
Tito sleeps under the stars, the moon smiles (ending)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Buenos días, Tito! ¡Ya salió el sol!
[Verse 1]
Manitas de colores, ¿a desayunar?
¡Primero agua y jabón, a lavar, lavar!
[Chorus]
¡Así, así, Tito lo hace así!
¡Así, así, qué feliz!
[Verse 2]
Barro en las orejas, barro en la nariz
¡Al baño con burbujas, splash, qué feliz!
[Chorus]
¡Así, así, Tito lo hace así!
¡Así, así, qué feliz!
[Verse 3]
Cepillo los dientes, arriba y abajo
Cepillo, cepillo, ¡qué brillo, qué trabajo!
[Chorus]
¡Así, así, Tito lo hace así!
¡Así, así, qué feliz!
[Verse 4]
Pijama y un cuento, un beso de mamá
La luna ya sale, ¡buenas noches ya!
[Outro]
Buenas noches, Tito, a soñar
style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
mama_lock: MAMÁ ELEFANTA, the mother of the baby elephant: a gentle grown-up adult elephant with motherly adult proportions, clearly taller and slimmer than a toddler, longer legs and a longer graceful trunk, soft lavender-grey body, big round ears with peach-pink insides, warm brown eyes with long eyelashes, a kind smile, wearing a soft lilac dress with tiny white polka dots, a white apron, and a small yellow flower behind one ear.

locations.cocina: A cozy warm kitchen in the morning, wide 16:9 composition, camera at child eye level: a round wooden table with a plate of fluffy pancakes and a glass of milk, mint-green wall tiles, orange curtains on a sunny window, a white sink with a little wooden step stool and a soap pump, potted plants. Nobody is in the kitchen.
locations.bano: A cheerful bathroom, wide 16:9 composition, camera at child eye level: turquoise and white tiles, a big white clawfoot bathtub overflowing with fluffy foam and rainbow soap bubbles, a yellow rubber duck toy, a small sink with a round mirror and a cup with a small blue toothbrush, a fluffy yellow towel on a hook. Nobody is in the bathroom.
locations.cuarto: A cozy child's bedroom at night, wide 16:9 composition, camera at child eye level: a small wooden bed with a soft blue blanket with star patterns, a big window showing a deep blue night sky with twinkling stars and a big friendly smiling moon, a warm little lamp, a shelf with picture books, a soft rug. Nobody is in the bedroom.

shots: Wide shot of the sunny kitchen in the morning: the baby elephant runs in happily toward the table, his little hands covered in colorful paint.
He runs toward the table with a happy bounce.
Close-up: the baby elephant's paint-covered hands reaching toward the pancakes, his hungry excited face behind.
His paint-covered hands reach slowly toward the pancakes.
Medium shot in the kitchen: Mamá Elefanta holds up her trunk like a friendly stop sign and points to the sink; the baby elephant looks at his hands.
Mamá points to the sink with a smile; the baby elephant looks at his hands and nods.
Close-up at the kitchen sink: the baby elephant on a little stool rubs his hands in a big cloud of white soap foam, rainbow bubbles float up.
His hands rub round and round in the foam, bubbles float up.
Close-up at the sink: the baby elephant shows his clean sparkling hands to the camera with a proud smile.
He holds up his clean hands proudly and wiggles them.
Medium shot at the kitchen table: the baby elephant and Mamá Elefanta eat pancakes together, he takes a happy bite.
He takes a happy bite and wiggles with joy; Mamá smiles.
Medium shot in the kitchen: the baby elephant dances happily with his arms up, swaying side to side.
He dances, swaying side to side with his arms up.
Close-up: the baby elephant's face covered in brown mud splats, mud on his ears and trunk, a guilty grin.
A drop of mud drips from his ear, he blinks and grins.
Medium shot in the bathroom: the baby elephant sits in the bubble bath, a big splash of water and foam flies around him, laughing.
Water splashes and foam flies, he laughs.
Close-up: the baby elephant in the bath with a white bubble beard and a tall bubble hat, laughing.
A bubble pops on his nose and he giggles.
Medium shot in the bathroom: the clean baby elephant wrapped in a fluffy yellow towel hugs Mamá Elefanta.
They hug and sway gently, sparkles twinkle.
Medium shot in the bathroom: the baby elephant dances happily with the towel on his head, swaying side to side.
He dances, swaying side to side.
Close-up in front of the bathroom mirror: the baby elephant brushes his teeth with a small blue toothbrush, white foam around his mouth.
He brushes up and down, foam bubbles float up.
Close-up: the baby elephant smiles big at the mirror, his clean teeth sparkle with tiny stars.
His teeth sparkle and he smiles proudly.
Medium shot in the bathroom: Mamá Elefanta claps happily next to the baby elephant holding his toothbrush up like a trophy.
Mamá claps and the baby elephant raises his toothbrush proudly.
Medium shot in the bedroom at night: the baby elephant in soft blue pajamas with stars sits in bed, Mamá Elefanta reads him a picture book.
Mamá turns a page and the baby elephant looks at the book with wonder.
Close-up: Mamá Elefanta gives the sleepy baby elephant a gentle goodnight kiss on the forehead, warm lamp light.
Mamá leans in for a gentle kiss, the baby elephant smiles sleepily.
Wide shot of the bedroom at night: the baby elephant asleep in his bed under the starry blanket, the big friendly moon smiling in the window, stars twinkling.
The stars twinkle softly and the moon smiles, the baby elephant breathes slowly in his sleep.
twist: each habit Tito skips makes a funny problem (paint pancakes, mud ears, a tiny cavity bug) — doing it fixes it with a reward
moral: ¡Así, así, Tito lo hace así! Un día limpio es un día feliz.
experiment: first long-form (2 min) habits episode with a repeating chorus; measure watch time vs episode 1
continuity: time of day: morning kitchen (E01-E07) -> evening bathroom (E08-E15) -> night bedroom (E16-E18); pajamas only from E16
